name: Gentle Box Breathing
description: Four steady sides: in, a short hold, out, a short hold. Holds are only two seconds.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A gentle box pattern with two-second pauses, on Breathing Space.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Go round the box as many times as you like.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in as the shape grows, pause briefly, breathe out as it shrinks, pause briefly.
If the pauses feel like too much, skip them and just keep breathing.
tips: Breathe in a way that feels easy. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
The pauses are short on purpose. You never need to hold your breath hard.
